// Three records, and one Gauge written once: the data decides how many.

App [

    facts: Dataset { { "rows": [
        { "label": "reactive", "n": 92 },
        { "label": "compiled", "n": 78 },
        { "label": "small",    "n": 64 } ] } },

    group: View [ x = center, y = center, width = 80%, datapath = { app.facts.value },
        layout: SimpleLayout [ axis = y, spacing = 20 ],

        Gauge [ width = 100%, datapath = :rows[], label = :label, value = :n ]
        ]
    ]
